description: Database engine: sqlite, postgres, mysql, sqlserver, oracle
SQLite: absolute path to the database file
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: server host name or address
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: TCP port (default 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL, 1433 for SQL Server, 1521 for Oracle)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server: database to connect to (for MySQL, also the default schema). Oracle: the service name (FREEPDB1, ORCLPDB1)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: login role, account or user (for SQL Server, a SQL Server login, or with auth windows another domain account)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: the login's password (a secret: env var or OS credential store)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle: connect over TLS (Oracle: TCPS), verifying the server's certificate against the OS store
SQL Server: sql (a SQL Server login, the default) or windows (Windows authentication, Windows only)
SQL Server with auth windows: the domain of the account in user, to sign in as someone other than the current Windows user
